classification_order: whole raw frames individually reviewed and labels frozen BEFORE candidate comparison

definitions.visible: target box unobscured by covering board
definitions.partial_occlusion: target face or rim remains visible
definitions.fully_occluded: no target face or rim identifiable
definitions.uncertain: tiny boundary cannot be identified confidently; excluded from full occlusion denominator

limits: visually selected windows, not random independent holdout
whole recordings were not completely reviewed
four fully hidden frames in one short run cannot certify loss/recovery delay
virtual risks are recomputed offline; not historical live ROS/physical FFB observations
